$comment: Single source of truth for the Open source section of the GitHub profile README and the portfolio's About page. Edit here only: README.md is regenerated from this file (scripts/oss/render-readme.mjs) and the portfolio fetches it at runtime. Every entry carries machine-checkable evidence; CI re-checks each piece against the live GitHub API (scripts/oss/verify-claims.mjs). Rules for what qualifies, and how the sync works: docs/open-source.md.
